data.name: Munabbihan
data.gender_notes: Munabbihan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who bestows abundantly, showering blessings upon others. The name Munabbihan carries the meaning “Giver of much” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Munabbihan usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of much and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing generosity and kindness towards others.
data.etymology: Munabbihan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver of much.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Munabbihan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: منبھان
in_arabic.meaning: المنبھان من الذين يوقظون الناس للصلاة والعبادة
in_arabic.long_meaning: المنبھان اسم مشتق من النبھ، وهو الإيقاظ والتنبيه. يطلق على من يوقظ الناس للصلاة والعبادة، ويعرف أيضًا بالمنذر والموذن. هذا الاسم يوحي بالمسؤولية الكبيرة في إيقاظ الناس للقيام بواجباتهم الدينية.

in_urdu.name: منبھان
in_urdu.meaning: منبھان وہ لوگ ہیں جو نماز اور عبادت کے لیے لوگوں کو جگاتے ہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: منبھان نام عربی زبان کے 'نبھ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے جگادنا یا تنبیہ کرنا۔ یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو لوگوں کو نماز اور عبادت کے لیے جگاتے ہیں، اور انہیں اپنے واجبات دینی کی ادائیگی کے لیے تحریک دیتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मुनब्बीहान
in_hindi.meaning: मुनब्बीहान वे लोग हैं जो पूजा और उपासना के लिए लोगों को जगाते हैं
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुनब्बीहान नाम अरबी भाषा के 'नब्ह' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है जगाना या चेतावनी देना। यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो लोगों को पूजा और उपासना के लिए जगाते हैं और उन्हें अपने धार्मिक कर्तव्यों के पालन के लिए प्रेरित करते हैं।

in_pashto.name: منبھان
in_pashto.meaning: منبھان هغه کسان دي چې د خلکو د لمانځه او عبادت لپاره راپاڅوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: منبھان نوم د عربي ژبې د 'نبھ' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د ویښولو یا خبرتیا ورکول دي. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې د خلکو د لمانځه او عبادت لپاره راپاڅوي او د هغوی د دیني وظایفو د ترسره کولو لپاره هڅوي.

This name carries significant spiritual connotations, emphasizing the importance of vigilance and the responsibility to guide others towards righteous actions.

This can be understood through various aspects of Islamic society, such as the belief in giving charity and generosity, as well as the practice of hospitality and kindness towards others. The title is also a reminder of the importance of creating a harmonious and supportive community, where members uplift and care for each other, mirroring the compassionate nature of God.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Munabbihan holds great significance as it encapsulates the essence of a selfless and generous servant of God. This is illustrated in the Hadith where Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) states, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his charity." By bestowing blessings and acting as a conduit for God's grace, one is not only physically helping others, but also directly contributing to their spiritual growth and wellbeing. Ultimately, Munabbihan is a name that embodies the divine qualities of compassion, love, and generosity, and is a constant inspiration and reminder to strive towards embodying these virtues in our daily lives.
